summary: Targeted verification of the sidebar progress bar bug fix in the course player (/learn/1). Logged in as learner@ifpi.org, navigated directly to /learn/1, jumped to the last slide via slide-nav-4 (skipping Next clicks — the original repro path), clicked Complete. Sidebar progress label transitioned from '0% complete' to '100% complete', all 5 slide-nav entries render checkmark icons, the learn-complete-card is visible, and the 'Course complete! Certificate issued.' toast fires. Bug fix confirmed working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 49 flagged sidebar progress staying at 20% after Complete from last slide (skip-nav repro). Fix in LearnPage.tsx next() handler (setCompleted with all slide indices before /complete POST) verified in iteration 50. Progress label now correctly reads '100% complete' and all slide-nav-* items show check icons.
rca of the issue: Original bug: sidebar `progress` was derived from local `completed` Set which only got the current slide index appended per Next click; jumping straight to the last slide meant only that one index was in the Set → 1/5 = 20%. Fix populates the Set with every slide index on final Complete, matching the server-side completion state. Confirmed 100% after fix.
